_about: Copy this file to assistant/tenants/<company-id>.json (lower case, no spaces, e.g. greatermoving.json) and fill it in. The company's own copy of the app on Render sets TENANT=<company-id>. Secrets never go here: tokens and passwords live in that copy's Render environment.

people._about: key_users see every to-do nobody owns, so nothing is lost. Each role lists who gets that kind of to-do when the product does not name a person. Leave a role out if the company has no such person.

auditrack._about: Turn on only when the company's move system (Moveware) is connected to this copy.
